Downloading UCDP data reproducibly

Source: vignettes/getting-started.Rmd
getting-started.Rmd

ucdpR treats UCDP’s official download page as the authoritative catalog. Start by discovering what is currently available:

library(ucdpR)
catalog <- ucdp_catalog()
ucdp_search("Georeferenced|Candidate", catalog)

Download or import

ucdp_download() preserves the original file. ucdp_get() additionally imports supported tabular formats.

file <- ucdp_download("prio", format = "csv", dest_dir = "data-raw")
conflicts <- ucdp_get("prio", format = "csv")

When several files belong to one dataset, specify a variant:

ucdp_search("Battle-Related Deaths", catalog)
brd_dyad <- ucdp_get("brd", format = "csv", variant = "dyadic")

Reproducibility

Pin versions in analysis scripts and keep immutable input files. Search the historical page when necessary:

ucdp_versions("prio", format = "csv")
old <- ucdp_download("prio", version = "24.1", format = "csv",
                     dest_dir = "data-raw")

# Compare frozen releases to study retrospective revisions
versions <- c("23.1", "24.1", "25.1")
snapshots <- setNames(lapply(versions, function(v) {
  ucdp_get("ged", version = v, format = "csv")
}), versions)

UCDP asks users to cite the relevant dataset publication and report the data version. Retrieve the current guidance with ucdp_cite("prio") and consult the dataset’s codebook before publication.
